parameters.content:
## PF Reward
Input: `{ invitee_uri }`. Called by PF Session Follow-up after the session ends, and later by the Darwin tool (manual path).

1. Choice: Send $50 / Other amount / No reward (links, back to Slack after the click).
2. Other: form link, whole dollars 1 to 100, one retry.
3. Confirm / Cancel.
4. Re-read the row (no second order), stub balance check (step 6b replaces it), Tremendous stub with `external_id` = invitee id.

No answer leaves the row as it is, so the manual path can pick it up.

nodeGroups.name: Check session
nodeGroups.description: Loads config and the row, stops if already rewarded or the host fails the mock guard, builds all texts.

nodeGroups.name: Ask reward
nodeGroups.description: DMs Send $50 / Other amount / No reward, waits, edits the message with the choice.

nodeGroups.name: Other amount
nodeGroups.description: DMs a form link for whole dollars 1 to 100 and waits for the form.

nodeGroups.name: Amount retry
nodeGroups.description: One retry when the amount is not valid.

nodeGroups.name: Confirm
nodeGroups.description: Asks Send $X to name (email)? with Confirm / Cancel, edits the message.

nodeGroups.name: Send reward
nodeGroups.description: Tremendous order (stub today), marks the row rewarded, shows the order id in the DM.

nodeGroups.name: Balance too low
nodeGroups.description: No order: row reward_blocked, DM explains. Admin DM comes in step 6b.
